extraction_notes: Pentanoic (valeric) acid C5H10O2 — C5 saturated acyclic monoacid; pungent odor; used in valerate esters (fragrance/flavor).
Palmitic acid C16H32O2 — C16 saturated fatty acid; key feedstock for soaps and cosmetic emulsifiers.
Stearic acid C18H36O2 — C18 saturated fatty acid; commonly tallow-derived; rubber/candle/soap raw material.
GMS — glycerol monostearate (stearate ester of glycerol). Classified here in 2915.70 (palmitic/stearic + esters) as ester of stearic acid.
H.C.O. = Hydrogenated Castor Oil fatty acid (12-hydroxy stearic acid); used as lithium-grease thickener.
D.C.O. = Dehydrated Castor Oil fatty acid (conjugated linoleic-type C18 fatty acid). Note: India classes DCO-fatty-acid under 2915.70 despite being unsaturated; following ITC schedule.
Residual basket under 2915.70 — other salts/esters of palmitic or stearic acid not separately tariffed.
Acetyl chloride CH3COCl — acid chloride of acetic acid; powerful acylating agent for amides/esters. Moisture-reactive.
Pivaloyl chloride (CH3)3CCOCl — t-butyl acid chloride; introduces pivaloyl protecting group.
n-Valeryl (pentanoyl) chloride C4H9COCl — C5 straight-chain acid chloride.
n-Octanoyl chloride C8H15ClO — caprylyl chloride; surfactant/peroxide chemistry intermediate.
Neodecanoyl chloride — branched C10 acid chloride (alpha,alpha-disubstituted). Used to make peroxyesters (polymerization initiators).
PFOA C8HF15O2 — restricted under Stockholm Convention (POPs). Historically used as PTFE polymerization surfactant.
Hexanoic (caproic) acid C6H12O2 — goat-like odor; intermediate for hexanoate esters (fruity flavors).
Octanoic (caprylic) acid C8H16O2 — medium chain fatty acid, derived from coconut/palm kernel. MCT precursor.
Trifluoroacetic acid CF3COOH — strong organic acid (pKa ~0.23); ubiquitous in peptide deprotection chemistry.
Ethyl difluoroacetate CHF2COOC2H5 — ester used as -CHF2 building block in drug discovery.
Ethyl trifluoroacetate CF3COOC2H5 — mild trifluoroacetylation reagent for amines.
Residual basket — other saturated acyclic monocarboxylic acids/derivatives not separately tariffed.
Acrylic acid CH2=CHCOOH and its salts — base monomer for polyacrylic acid (SAP), acrylate esters.
n-Butyl acrylate CH2=CHCOOC4H9 — soft-monomer for emulsion polymers (paints, PSA adhesives).
Other esters of acrylic acid (methyl/ethyl/2-EHA etc.) not separately tariffed in 2916.12.
Methacrylic acid CH2=C(CH3)COOH — precursor to MMA and methacrylate polymers (PMMA).
Salts of methacrylic acid (e.g., sodium/zinc methacrylate). Crosslinking agents in rubber.
Esters of methacrylic acid (MMA, BMA, HEMA, etc.) — acrylic-glass monomers.
Oleic acid C18H34O2 — cis-9 monounsaturated C18; from olive/animal fats.
Other oleic/linoleic/linolenic acid derivatives (salts, esters) — polyunsaturated C18 fatty acids.
Binapacryl (ISO) — dinitrophenol ester acaricide/fungicide; PIC-listed pesticide.
Undecylenic acid C11H20O2 — 10-undecenoic acid from castor oil pyrolysis; antifungal active.
Bismuth salt (e.g., bismuth oleate) of unsaturated acyclic monoacids — metal soap.
Potassium salt of unsaturated acyclic monoacids (e.g., potassium oleate) — soft soap component.
Sodium salt of unsaturated acyclic monoacids (e.g., sodium oleate) — hard soap.
Gossyplure — sex pheromone (acetate ester of hexadecadienol) of pink bollworm Pectinophora gossypiella.
Other esters of unsaturated acyclic monoacids n.e.s.
Sorbic acid (2E,4E-hexadienoic acid) C6H8O2 — yeast/mold inhibitor in cheese, baked goods.
Erucic acid C22H42O2 — cis-13 monounsaturated C22; from high-erucic rapeseed (HEAR); precursor to erucamide slip agent.
Residual — other unsaturated acyclic monoacids/derivatives n.e.s.
D.V. acid chloride = dichlorovinyl-dimethylcyclopropane carboxylic acid chloride; cypermethrin/permethrin precursor.
Bifenthrin (ISO) + prallethrin — type I synthetic pyrethroids (cyclopropanecarboxylate esters).
Other cyclanic/cyclenic/cycloterpenic monoacids and their derivatives n.e.s.
Benzoic acid C6H5COOH — simplest aromatic monoacid; preservative E210.
Benzyl benzoate PhCOOCH2Ph — used topically for scabies; balsamic odor.
Methyl benzoate PhCOOCH3 — feijoa/wintergreen-like aroma; perfumery.
Sodium benzoate PhCOONa — E211 preservative; water-soluble form for soft drinks.
Benzocaine = ethyl 4-aminobenzoate; surface anesthetic. Note: amino group, but tariffed in 2916.31 as PABA-ester.
o-Chlorobenzoic acid (2-chlorobenzoic acid) — Ullmann coupling substrate; herbicide intermediate.
Dicamba = 3,6-dichloro-2-methoxybenzoic acid — auxin-mimic herbicide on broadleaf weeds.
Residual basket — other benzoic acid salts/esters/derivatives n.e.s.
Benzoyl peroxide (BPO) and benzoyl chloride — radical initiator + acylating agent respectively.
Phenylacetic acid PhCH2COOH — penicillin-G precursor; honey-like odor.
Cinnamic acid PhCH=CHCOOH (trans) — from cinnamon/styrax; honey-floral odor.
Bismuth salts of aromatic monoacids (e.g., bismuth benzoate).
Potassium salts of aromatic monoacids — e.g., potassium phenylacetate.
Sodium salts of aromatic monoacids — e.g., sodium phenylacetate (PKU drug).
Esters of aromatic monoacids n.e.s.
Dichlorophenyl acetyl chloride — DDT-class intermediate / pesticide manufacture.
Goods specified in Supplementary Note 2 to Ch.29 (India-specific list of bulk drugs/agrochemicals under 2916.39).
Residual basket — other aromatic monoacid derivatives n.e.s.
Oxalic acid (COOH)2 — smallest dicarboxylic acid; strong chelator for Ca/Fe. Dihydrate is common.
Calcium oxalate CaC2O4 — kidney-stone constituent; ceramic/refractory use.
Strontium oxalate SrC2O4 — red-color source in fireworks/flares.
Diethyl oxalate (EtOOC-COOEt) — Claisen condensation reagent.
Other oxalic acid salts/esters n.e.s.
Adipic acid HOOC(CH2)4COOH — C6 diacid; nylon-6,6 monomer paired with hexamethylenediamine.
Azelaic acid C9 + sebacic acid C10 — longer dicarboxylics; sebacic from castor oil. Polyamide/polyester feedstock.
Other salts/esters of azelaic/sebacic acid n.e.s.
Maleic anhydride C4H2O3 — UPR feedstock; Diels-Alder dienophile.
Maleic acid (cis-butenedioic acid) — hydrated form of maleic anhydride.
Malonic acid HOOC-CH2-COOH — C3 diacid; barbiturate precursor via diethyl malonate.
Succinic acid HOOC(CH2)2COOH — C4 diacid; Krebs cycle metabolite; bio-PBS monomer.
Ferrous fumarate Fe(C4H2O4) — iron(II) salt of fumaric acid; oral iron supplement.
Fumaric acid (trans-butenedioic acid) — geometric isomer of maleic acid; E297.
Itaconic acid (methylenesuccinic acid) — bio-based unsaturated diacid from Aspergillus fermentation; SAP/coating monomer.
Ethoxymethylene malonate (EMME) + diethyl malonate — quinolone (e.g., nalidixic acid) and barbiturate synthesis reagents.
Isoprothiolane — diisopropyl 1,3-dithiolan-2-ylidenemalonate; rice-blast systemic fungicide.
Residual basket — other acyclic polycarboxylic acid derivatives n.e.s.
Cyclanic/cyclenic/cycloterpenic polycarboxylic acids — e.g., cyclohexane-1,2-dicarboxylic acid; HHPA-precursor.
Dioctyl orthophthalates (DOP/DEHP) — workhorse PVC plasticizer; restricted in toys.
Dinonyl (DNP) and didecyl (DDP) orthophthalates — higher-MW PVC plasticizers (better permanence).
Other esters of orthophthalic acid (e.g., DIDP, DINP, DIBP) — phthalate plasticizer family.
Phthalic anhydride C8H4O3 — feedstock for phthalates, alkyd resins, dyes.
Terephthalic acid (PTA/TPA) — para-isomer C8H6O4; PET monomer (with MEG). Huge commodity.
DMT (CH3OOC-C6H4-COOCH3) — pre-PTA route to PET; transesterification with ethylene glycol.
Dibutyl phthalate DBP — short-chain phthalate plasticizer; reproductive toxicant, restricted.
Dioctyl isophthalate (DOIP) + dioctyl terephthalate (DOTP/DEHT) — non-ortho phthalate plasticizers; DOTP replaces DEHP.
Phthalic acid (ortho-benzenedicarboxylic acid) C8H6O4 — hydrated form of phthalic anhydride.
Dimethyl phthalate DMP — mosquito repellent; cellulose-acetate plasticizer.
Trimellitic anhydride TMA C9H4O5 — 1,2,4-benzene anhydride; trimellitate plasticizer + polyimide precursor.
Isophthalic acid (meta-benzenedicarboxylic acid) — co-monomer for UPR, PET-G, and aramid copolymers.
Residual basket — other aromatic polycarboxylic acid derivatives n.e.s.
Lactic acid CH3CH(OH)COOH — 2-hydroxypropanoic acid; E270 food acidulant + PLA bioplastic monomer.
Calcium lactate Ca(C3H5O3)2 — E327; calcium fortifier in juices and bread.
Other lactic acid salts/esters n.e.s. — e.g., ethyl lactate (green solvent), sodium lactate.
Tartaric acid (2,3-dihydroxysuccinic acid) — wine-cask deposit origin; E334.
Potassium bitartrate KHC4H4O6 — cream of tartar; baking-powder acid component.
Metoprolol tartrate — beta-1 selective adrenergic blocker (Lopressor); tartrate counter-ion gives water solubility.
Other tartaric acid salts/esters n.e.s. — e.g., sodium-potassium tartrate (Rochelle salt), dibutyl tartrate.
Citric acid C6H8O7 — 2-hydroxy-1,2,3-propanetricarboxylic acid; E330; Aspergillus niger fermentation product.
Potassium citrate K3C6H5O7 — E332; treats kidney stones, alkalinizes urine.
Sodium citrate (trisodium) Na3C6H5O7 — E331(iii); calcium chelator for blood bag anticoagulation.
Bismuth citrate — basis for ranitidine bismuth citrate / colloidal bismuth subcitrate; ulcer drug.
Disodium hydrogen citrate Na2HC6H5O7 — E331(ii); mid-pH buffer in foods/parenterals.
Ferric ammonium citrate (FAC) — variable Fe(III) citrate complex; iron tonic + cyanotype photosensitizer.
Other citric acid salts/esters n.e.s. — e.g., triethyl citrate (PVC plasticizer), calcium citrate.
Calcium gluconate Ca(C6H11O7)2 — IV antidote for HF burns + hypocalcemia.
Ferrous gluconate Fe(C6H11O7)2 — E579; well-tolerated oral iron salt for anemia; black-olive color stabilizer.
Other gluconic acid salts/esters n.e.s. — e.g., sodium gluconate (cement set retarder), zinc gluconate.
Benzilic acid (Ph)2C(OH)COOH — product of benzilic acid rearrangement of benzil; precursor to BZ (incapacitating CW agent).
Chlorobenzilate (ISO) — ethyl 4,4'-dichlorobenzilate; DDT-related acaricide; banned in many jurisdictions.
alpha-Hydroxy-alpha-phenyl benzeneacetic acid — synonym for benzilic acid analog (Ph)(C6H5)C(OH)COOH; muscarinic antagonist scaffold.
Cholic acid C24H40O5 — primary bile acid (3,7,12-trihydroxy-5beta-cholanoic acid); ox-bile derived; biosurfactant.
Ricinoleic acid C18H34O3 — 12-hydroxy-9-cis-octadecenoic acid; ~90% of castor oil fatty acids.
Other alcohol-function carboxylic acids n.e.s. — e.g., glycolic acid, mandelic acid, malic acid derivatives.
Salicylic acid C7H6O3 — Kolbe-Schmitt product from sodium phenoxide + CO2; aspirin precursor; topical keratolytic.
Sodium salicylate — pre-aspirin NSAID; water-soluble; analgesic/antipyretic.
Other salicylic acid salts n.e.s. — e.g., choline salicylate, magnesium salicylate.
Aspirin (O-acetylsalicylic acid) — Bayer 1899; irreversible COX-1/2 inhibitor; low-dose cardioprotection.
Methyl salicylate — oil of wintergreen; characteristic odor; counterirritant in Bengay-type liniments.
Aminosalicylate — sodium or other salt of para-aminosalicylic acid (PAS); second-line antitubercular.
Salicylamide C7H7NO2 — 2-hydroxybenzamide; OTC analgesic in compound cold/flu products.
Benzyl salicylate — fragrance fixative (floral, balsamic) + UVB absorber; ylang-ylang note.
Other esters of salicylic acid n.e.s. — phenyl salicylate (salol), glycol salicylate.
Gallic acid 3,4,5-trihydroxybenzoic acid — gallnut hydrolysis product; iron-gall ink chemistry.
BON acid (3-hydroxy-2-naphthoic acid) — Kolbe-Schmitt of beta-naphthol; coupling component for lithol/BON-arylide red pigments.
Propyl gallate (PG) — E310; lipid-soluble antioxidant; protects fats from rancidity.
Residual basket — other phenol-function carboxylic acids n.e.s. — e.g., 2,6-dihydroxybenzoic acid, vanillic acid.
Levulinic acid (4-oxopentanoic acid) — DOE Top-12 biomass-derived platform chemical from cellulose hydrolysis.
Ethyl acetoacetate CH3COCH2COOC2H5 — classic Claisen self-condensation product; acetoacetic ester synthesis.
Nalidixic acid — first-generation quinolone antibacterial (1962); progenitor of fluoroquinolones.
Methyl acetoacetate CH3COCH2COOCH3 — lower homolog of EAA; arylide yellow pigment intermediate.
4-Fluoro benzoyl butyric acid — key building block for butyrophenone antipsychotics (haloperidol class).
Diclofop-methyl (herbicide) + d-trans-allethrin/pyrethrin (insecticides) — keto-function carboxylate pesticides.
Other carboxylic acids with aldehyde/ketone function n.e.s. — e.g., pyruvic acid, glyoxylic acid derivatives.
2,4,5-T — phenoxy auxin herbicide; Agent Orange component (with 2,4-D); banned due to TCDD contamination.
Sodium phenoxyacetate PhOCH2COONa — phenoxy-ether acid salt; aryloxy herbicide intermediate.
Methyl (E)-2-[2-(chloromethyl)phenyl]-3-methoxyacrylate — kresoxim-methyl/picoxystrobin precursor; strobilurin fungicide chemistry.
Goods specified in Supplementary Note 3 to Ch.29 — India-specific list (2,4-D, MCPA, fenoxaprop, etc. — oxygen-function phenoxy acids).
Residual basket — other carboxylic acids with additional oxygen function n.e.s.
TDBPP — tris(2,3-dibromopropyl) phosphate; banned 1977 children's-sleepwear flame retardant; mutagenic.
Glycerophosphoric acid C3H9O6P — phosphate ester of glycerol; phospholipid backbone analog.
Calcium glycerophosphate Ca(C3H7O6P) — dual Ca/P supplement; enamel-remineralizer in toothpaste.
Iron glycerophosphate Fe(C3H7O6P) — iron tonic with dual Fe/P contribution.
Sodium glycerophosphate Na2(C3H7O6P) — organic phosphate source for TPN admixtures (no Ca-precipitation risk).
Tricresyl phosphate TCP — antiwear additive in turbine oil; o-isomer (TOCP) neurotoxic (jamaica ginger paralysis).
Other phosphoric esters and salts n.e.s. — e.g., TBP (uranium extraction), TBEP, TXP.
Parathion + parathion-methyl — O,O-dialkyl O-(4-nitrophenyl) phosphorothioate insecticides; WHO Class Ia; PIC-listed.
Amiton — phosphorothioate (S-2-diethylaminoethyl O,O-diethyl ester); CWC Schedule 2 (V-series precursor); withdrawn insecticide.
Other phosphorothioates (halogenated/sulphonated/nitrated derivatives) — broad OP pesticide intermediate class.
Edifenphos + iprobenfos (kitazin) — rice-blast OP fungicides; fenitrothion — broad-spectrum OP insecticide.
Residual basket — other phosphorothioates n.e.s.
Dimethyl phosphite (MeO)2P(O)H — Michaelis-Arbuzov precursor; glyphosate intermediate.
Diethyl phosphite (EtO)2P(O)H — Pudovik/Abramov reaction reagent; α-aminophosphonate synthesis.
Trimethyl phosphite P(OMe)3 — Arbuzov rearrangement substrate; sulphur-scavenger.
Triethyl phosphite P(OEt)3 — Arbuzov→diethyl phosphonates for HWE olefinations.
Dimethyl sulphate (MeO)2SO2 — potent methylating agent on O/N nucleophiles; carcinogen.
Diethyl sulphate (EtO)2SO2 — ethylating reagent (less reactive than DMS); IARC Group 2A.
TDBPP residual entry (India retained legacy 8-digit for non-phosphite acid esters); same chemistry as 2919.10.00.
Other esters of inorganic acids of non-metals n.e.s. — sulphates, boronates etc. not separately tariffed.
Endosulfan — cyclic sulphite ester of hexachlorohexahydromethano-benzodioxathiepine; Stockholm POP (2011 ban).
Propargite — 2-(4-tert-butylphenoxy)cyclohexyl prop-2-yn-1-yl sulphite; spider-mite control (Omite).
Ethylphosphonic acid C2H5P(O)(OH)2 — alkylphosphonic acid; CWC Schedule 2 precursor watchlist.
Residual basket — other esters of inorganic acids of non-metals n.e.s.
DMF HCON(CH3)2 — workhorse polar aprotic solvent (Note: India uses 'dimethyl formide' spelling); reproductive toxicant.
Methylamine/dimethylamine/trimethylamine and salts n.e.s. — typically shipped in 40% aqueous solution for safety.
2-(N,N-Dimethylamino)ethyl chloride HCl — antihistamine intermediate (diphenhydramine class) + V-agent precursor (CWC Schedule 2B).
2-(N,N-Diethylamino)ethyl chloride HCl — procainamide/local-anesthetic intermediate; CWC Schedule 2B.
2-(N,N-Diisopropylamino)ethyl chloride HCl — direct VX precursor; CWC Schedule 2B; tight export controls.
2-Chloro N,N-Diisopropyl ethylamine — non-protonated form of VX precursor; CWC Schedule 2B.
2-Chloro N,N-Dimethyl ethanamine — non-protonated 2-(N,N-dimethylamino)ethyl chloride; tricyclic-antidepressant intermediate.
Other N,N-dialkyl-2-chloroethylamines n.e.s. — CWC Schedule 2B class.
Chlormequat chloride (CCC) — 2-chloroethyltrimethylammonium chloride; gibberellin biosynthesis inhibitor; shortens cereal stems.
Other acyclic monoamines n.e.s. — e.g., n-butylamine, ethylamine derivatives, fatty amines (when <C12).
Ethylenediamine H2NCH2CH2NH2 — EDA; EDTA monomer (with chloroacetic acid); polyamide-fiber finish; epoxy curing agent.
Hexamine (CH2)6N4 — formaldehyde+ammonia condensation; phenolic resin hardener; not put up as fuel tablet (per tariff wording).
Trimethylenetrinitramine (cyclonite/RDX) — 1,3,5-trinitro-1,3,5-triazinane; controlled high explosive. (India tariff spelling: 'triniframine'.)
Other acyclic polyamines n.e.s. — e.g., DETA, TETA, TEPA (polyamine ladder); epoxy-amine hardeners.
Cyclohexylamine C6H11NH2 — boiler-feedwater pH adjuster/CO2 scavenger; cyclamate sweetener precursor.
Other cyclanic/cyclenic/cycloterpenic mono- or polyamines n.e.s. — e.g., dicyclohexylamine, isophoronediamine.
Aniline C6H5NH2 — phenylamine; world's largest aromatic amine; MDI/polyurethane and dye industry feedstock.
Aniline hydrochloride C6H5NH3Cl — water-soluble salt; aniline black dye precursor.
6-Benzyladenine (BAP) — synthetic cytokinin for plant tissue culture; beflubutamid — phytoene-desaturase herbicide.
Other aniline derivatives/salts n.e.s.
p-Chloroaniline (4-CA) C6H6ClN — azo-dye coupling component; diuron herbicide intermediate; suspected carcinogen.
2-Chloro-4-nitroaniline — Pigment Yellow / azo-coupling diazo component.
Dichloroaniline isomers (3,4-DCA most common) — diuron/linuron herbicide and dye intermediate. Tariff allows isomer mix.
2,6-Dichloro-4-nitroaniline (dicloran/DCNA) — botrytis fungicide active.
2,4,5-Trichloroaniline — diazo component for highly fast azo pigments.
N-benzyl-N-ethylaniline — coupling component for victoria blue / acid violet triarylmethane dyes.
N,N-Diethylaniline C6H5N(C2H5)2 — coupler for diazo dyes; photo-initiator co-reactant in dental composites.
N,N-Dimethylaniline C6H5N(CH3)2 — peroxide-cure accelerator for unsaturated polyesters; methyl violet precursor.
N-Ethylaniline C6H5NHC2H5 — secondary amine; coupling component; herbicide intermediate.
m-Nitroaniline (3-NA) — diazo coupling component; intermediate to m-phenylenediamine via reduction.
p-Nitroaniline (4-NA) — paranitroaniline red precursor; intermediate to p-phenylenediamine (hair dye).
2-amino-3,5-xylenesulphonic acid — sulphonated xylidine for fast acid-yellow dyes.
Benzyl ethyl aniline sulphonic acid — sulphonation product for water-soluble dye chromophore; light-green SF intermediate.
Metanilic acid (3-aminobenzenesulphonic acid) — diazo component for fast yellow / orange azo dyes.
Sulphanilic acid (4-aminobenzenesulphonic acid) — Methyl Orange and sulphonamide drug synthesis (sulphanilamide).
N-Ethyl-N-(2-hydroxyethyl)aniline — coupling component for cationic disperse dyes; color-photo developer.
Methyldopa — alpha-methyl-L-DOPA; centrally-acting alpha-2 agonist; first-line in pregnancy hypertension. Tariff lists it under aniline despite being amino acid.
Fluchloralin/pendimethalin/trifluralin — 2,6-dinitroaniline pre-emergent herbicides; mitotic disruptors.
Other aniline derivatives n.e.s.
N,N-Diethyl-p-toluidine (DEPT) — UPR room-temp cure accelerator with BPO.
N,N-Dimethyl-p-toluidine (DMPT) — bone-cement cure accelerator; suspected carcinogen.
o-Toluidine (2-methylaniline) — Bismarck Brown dye precursor; IARC Group 1 carcinogen (bladder).
m-Toluidine (3-methylaniline) — toluidine red / DEET intermediate.
p-Toluidine (4-methylaniline) — Para Red / toluidine red diazo component.
2-Chloro-5-toluidine-4-sulphonic acid — chlorinated toluidine sulphonic acid; light-fast azo-pigment intermediate.
Sodium salt of 2-chloro-4-toluidine-5-sulphonic acid — pre-neutralized diazo component for monoazo dyes.
4-Toluidine-3-sulphonic acid — direct red intermediate.
Ethalfluralin — fluorinated dinitroaniline pre-emergent herbicide (sunflowers/peanuts).
Other toluidines/salts n.e.s.
Diphenylamine (Ph)2NH — radical-scavenger; stabilizer in single-base smokeless powder; apple post-harvest treatment.
Other diphenylamine derivatives — e.g., 4-aminodiphenylamine, octylated DPA (rubber antioxidants).
alpha-Naphthylamine (1-NA) — diazo coupling; co-contaminated with beta-naphthylamine (bladder carcinogen).
PANA — Phenyl-alpha-naphthylamine; secondary diarylamine; rubber and turbine-oil antioxidant.
PBNA — Phenyl-beta-naphthylamine; historical rubber antioxidant; banned in EU due to beta-naphthylamine contamination.
Amino F-acid — 2-amino-3,6-naphthalenedisulphonic acid; dye intermediate (acid black couplers).
Aminoline-R-acid — aminonaphthalene disulphonic acid R-isomer; direct dye coupling component.
Sodium naphthionate — sodium salt of naphthionic acid (1-aminonaphthalene-4-sulphonic acid); congo red intermediate.
Bronner's acid — 2-naphthylamine-6-sulphonic acid; diazo for fast scarlet pigments.
Cleve's acid — 1-naphthylamine-6-sulphonic acid; direct azo dye coupling.
Epsilon acid — 1-naphthylamine-3,8-disulphonic acid; coupling for direct red dyes.
Koch's acid — 1-naphthylamine-3,6,8-trisulphonic acid; highly water-soluble acid-dye precursor.
Laurent's acid — 1-naphthylamine-5-sulphonic acid; intermediate in azo and stilbene dye chemistry.
Tobias acid — 2-naphthylamine-1-sulphonic acid; diazo for lithol red pigments (PR49).
Naphthionic acid — 1-naphthylamine-4-sulphonic acid; classical Congo red coupling component.
p-Tolyl peri acid — N-(p-tolyl)-1-naphthylamine-8-sulphonic acid; coupler for acid milling dyes.
Phenyl peri acid — N-phenyl-1-naphthylamine-8-sulphonic acid; chrome-mordant dye intermediate.
Other naphthylamines and their sulphonated derivatives n.e.s.
Amphetamine class psychostimulants (INN list) — phenethylamine scaffold; UN 1971 Schedule II controlled.
Xylidines (dimethylanilines) — 6 isomers; technical grade often isomer mix; lidocaine/mefenamic acid precursor.
p-Cumidine — 4-isopropylaniline (4-cumyl amine); cymoxanil agrochemical precursor.
Other aromatic monoamines n.e.s.
o-Phenylenediamine — 1,2-diaminobenzene; benzimidazole/quinoxaline scaffold precursor; thiabendazole synthesis.
m-Phenylenediamine (MPDA) — Nomex/Twaron aramid monomer (with isophthaloyl chloride); epoxy hardener.
p-Phenylenediamine (PPDA) — Kevlar aramid monomer; permanent hair dye primary intermediate; sensitizer.
o-Toluenediamine — TDA isomer; toluene diisocyanate (TDI) precursor via phosgenation.
2,4-Toluenediamine — primary TDI precursor (after phosgenation); IARC Group 2B.
2,5-Toluenediamine (PTDA) — common hair-dye intermediate (gentler than PPD).
4-Aminoacetanilide — mono-acetylated p-phenylenediamine; selective protection in dye synthesis.
m-Toluylenediamine — alternate name for 2,4-/2,6-TDA mixture; classic basic-brown chrysoidine intermediate.
Other o-/m-/p-phenylenediamines, o-/m-/p-diaminotoluenes n.e.s. (including their derivatives, salts).
Benzidine 4,4'-diaminobiphenyl — IARC Group 1 (bladder cancer); banned for dye manufacture in most jurisdictions.
Benzidine dihydrochloride — water-soluble HCl salt for blood-detection (Kastle-Meyer) test (historical).
3,3'-Dichlorobenzidine dihydrochloride sulphate — DCB salt; diarylide yellow pigment (PY12/13/14) intermediate.
DASDA — 4,4'-diaminostilbene-2,2'-disulphonic acid; key intermediate for optical brightening agents (FWAs) in detergent/paper.
Other aromatic polyamines n.e.s. — e.g., MDA (4,4'-methylenedianiline → MDI precursor).
Monoethanolamine HOCH2CH2NH2 — primary amine; CCS/natural-gas sweetening absorbent; ethyleneimine precursor.
Other salts of monoethanolamine n.e.s.
Diethanolamine (HOCH2CH2)2NH — DEA; mustard-gas-precursor watchlist (CWC); cocoamide DEA precursor.
Dextropropoxyphene (Darvon) — mild opioid (mu agonist); cardiotoxicity → withdrawn in EU/US (2010); UN 1961 Schedule II.
Triethanolamine (HOCH2CH2)3N — TEA; pH adjuster + emulsifier in personal care; portland-cement grinding aid.
Diethanolammonium PFOS — DEA salt of perfluorooctane sulphonate; Stockholm POP-listed (Annex B).
MDEA — tertiary methyldiethanolamine; selective H2S over CO2 absorption in refineries.
Ethyldiethanolamine — tertiary amino-alcohol; lower-volatility selective gas absorbent.
2-(N,N-Diisopropylamino)ethanol — VX precursor (chlorinated to 2-Cl-diisopropylaminoethane); CWC Schedule 2B.
DMAE (deanol) — N,N-dimethyl-2-aminoethanol; PU catalyst; cosmetic skin firming; CWC Schedule 2B.

Methyl anthranilate — characteristic Concord grape aroma; goose/starling bird repellent for crops.

Domperidone — peripheral D2 antagonist; antiemetic + lactation stimulant; does not cross BBB.

Other phosphoaminolipids n.e.s. — e.g., sphingomyelin, phosphatidylethanolamine, phosphatidylserine.
